metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly get rid of clicking, popping, and cracking sounds in the neck. 

The main cause of these noises is a buildup of muscle tightness and joint stiffness. To fix this, the video demonstrates easy exercises that help loosen the neck and quickly reduce those annoying sounds.

Each exercise works differently and targets specific muscles associated with neck popping and clicking. For the best results, go through all of them and use the ones that work best for you.

Watch now and instantly stop neck popping and clicking sounds!

Link to peanut massage tool: https://amzn.to/3LPJH9E
